intro.text: Captain Eusto, an Eelakin who works for the Northern Interests Trading Company.

items.text: Eusto captained the company's ironhull steamship on the expedition that brought Vathi to Patji, seeking a permanent outpost there for the island's valuable Aviar. He resented her presence, fearing she would undercut his authority.

Armed with weapons from the Ones Above, the expedition killed a deepwalker and built a fortress on the island. When the party scouting a site for a second one was wiped out, stranding Vathi in the jungle, she suspected Eusto was glad she had not come back.
The expedition also carried a large machine from the Ones Above, able to map where the island's Aviar were, though the crew did not understand how it worked.
